whats the difference between sus and cringe

sus means short for suspicious, used when something or someone seems shady, off, or not quite right. it got huge from the game among us where you'd accuse someone of being sus if they were acting weird. cringe on the other hand means when something is so embarrassing or awkward to watch that it makes you physically uncomfortable, like secondhand embarrassment. can describe a person, a video, or just a random moment. so they're related but not really the same thing
